descriptions.zh-Hans: 在伦敦吃炸鱼薯条后留下的小菜单。盘子旁边的锯齿，是我记第一口脆响的办法。
descriptions.en: My London fish-and-chips menu. The little zigzag beside the plate recalls the first crisp bite.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 伦敦下午茶的回想：司康、三明治、小蛋糕和茶。旁边的小逗号，是我讲故事时停下来吃东西的空当。
descriptions.en: Scones, sandwiches, little cakes and tea from a London afternoon. The comma marks where my story paused for a bite.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在伦敦塔桥和旅人交换方向时，我画的两个箭头。一个记来路，一个等午饭后再决定。
descriptions.en: Two arrows from a conversation on Tower Bridge in London: one for the way here, one awaiting a decision after lunch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 伦敦下午茶时自己写的小纸条。一个逗号，替端起司康的那次停顿占了座。
descriptions.en: A note I made over afternoon tea in London. One comma keeps a place for the pause when I picked up a scone.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在伦敦邱园给自己留的便签。名字还有一半没想起来，“今天见过”四个字已经写好了。
descriptions.en: My note from Kew in London. Half the plant name is still missing, but “met today” is safely written down.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在伦敦把塔桥上的路和河上的小船记成一张折卡。打开它，能跟着那天的目光走一小段。
descriptions.en: My handmade London card pairs the path on Tower Bridge with a boat below. Unfold it to follow the small journey my eyes made.
